Looking at the qlang documentation, I need to write queries that process the input data through pipelines. Let me work through each task carefully.

T1: Count active users with non-null emails ending in "@example.com" (case-insensitive)
T2: Get names of users with "admin" role (case-insensitive), sorted by lowercase name
T3: Count users per country (null/missing → "unknown")
T4: Average age of users with non-null ages, rounded to 2 decimals
T5: Open issues: collect label names, lowercase, deduplicate, sort
T6: Top 3 issues by comments desc, ties broken by number asc
T7: Count open issues per assignee (excluding null assignees)
T8: Dependencies with "^", formatted as "name@version", sorted
T9: Services with enabled=true and port>8000, lowercased names, comma-joined
T10: ERROR count per service (3rd whitespace-separated token)
T11: Average of ms=<integer> values, rounded to 1 decimal
T12: Sum of qty*price for shipped rows (case-insensitive), non-empty prices
T13: Top 2 customers by total spend (excluding cancelled and empty prices)
T14: Process word list: lowercase, deduplicate, sort by length desc then alphabetically, join with "-"

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (/email | ne null) (/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count

T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles * lower | any ~(eq "admin")) | * /name | sort ~(lower)

T3: /data/users * (at /profile/country | coalesce "unknown") | groupBy * count

T4: /data/users * at /profile/age | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2

T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * /name | * lower | distinct | sort

T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at /assignee/login)}

T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * at /assignee/login | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy * count

T8: [(/dependencies | entries) (/devDependencies | entries)] | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * (/0 | append "@" | append /1) | sort

T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at /enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000)) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","

T10: split "\n" | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy * count

T11: split "\n" | filter ~(contains "ms=") | * (split " " | filter ~(contains "ms=") | first | split "=" | /1 | parseJson) | avg | round 1

T12: split "\n" | drop 1 | * ((split "," | if (allOf (/5 | lower | eq "shipped") (/4 | ne "")) ~({:a (at /3 | parseJson) :b (at /4 | parseJson)} | mulOf /a /b) ~(0)) !| 0) | sum | round 2

T13: split "\n" | drop 1 | filter ~(allOf (/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") (/4 | ne "")) | * (split "," | {:customer /1 :revenue ({:a (at /3 | parseJson) :b (at /4 | parseJson)} | mulOf /a /b !| 0)}) | groupBy ~(/customer) * sum ~(/revenue) | entries | sort ~((/1 | desc)) | take 2 | * {:customer /0 :total (/1 | round 2)}

T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
